name: Taiga Isami
source:
Isami avoids [url=/c98550]Hikaru[/url]'s zealous coaching during Judo practice, preferring to do things at her own pace. She's very physically fit and often seen as the tough type, so she finds it hard to admit that she likes cute things. Isami often takes care of her younger brother and sister in the stead of her parents.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
